artifact.canonical_name: Adaptive Evaluation of Out-of-Band Defenses Against Prompt Injection in LLM Agents

sources.title: Primary source 1: http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.26479v1
sources.role: Primary source used for chronology and technical verification

claims.text: The authors argue prompt-injection defenses must be evaluated with adaptive, defense-aware attacks rather than a fixed attack suite.

limitations.text: The evidence is the authors' arXiv paper/model card and reported evaluations; results are not independently reproduced in this Evidence review.

targets.target: verify surveyed defenses and adaptive evaluation method
targets.finding: The paper surveys out-of-band prompt-injection defenses, argues fixed attacks are insufficient, and runs a defense-aware adaptive evaluation protocol against Progent on AgentDojo.
